description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Radial' which extends 'Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing'. It implements a radial pointing marker used in graph rendering, representing a marker at a specified radius and random angle from a data point.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Radial
classes.description: A class representing a radial pointing marker with a specified radius and random angle, used in graph rendering.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Radial
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the radial marker with a given radius and parent marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Private method that calculates a random angle, determines the delta X and Y based on the radius, and calls parent method to draw the marker.
